# A row: case<TAB>input<TAB>expect<TAB>note. The form — the package README.

column4: note
shared: the live ones with a slot released=false and holder — in the pool; a heartbeat that is not live — not; a server without a live one — placeable false
a slot released=true, taking or an empty holder — not live; no slot row — not live
the draining and the retired servers — outside the pool, placeable false
requires: resource — a silent resource subtracts; unknown and live — do not
requires: none — a silent resource does not subtract
grows: true, readable order rows — retiring and a number above want are outside the pool
grows: false — «a number above want» and retiring do not apply (a live t-srv-a-1 and above want — in the pool)
grows: true, the server has no order row — the rules do not apply to its processes
grows: true, the order row is unreadable — they do not apply (the script does not stop by it); retiring — only from a readable one
distinct: the keeper — the largest load (Σ of the weights weight.field, not the number of units); the others — idle_by_policy
distinct: an equal load — the first in slot order (t-2 before t-10)
distinct, two live ones of one server: an unreadable assignment — the worker is outside the pool and at the console, the keeper — the other one
distinct: no assignment row — load 0; the keeper — the one with load, the new one — idle
distinct, both without assignment — the keeper — the first in slot order
the load with the reserve of an active intent: members at target
place_by a heartbeat field: "" — no place, idle_by_policy true; a server with only such — placeable false
a worker that is not live — idle_by_policy false and not a keeper
load: no unit row, unreadable, the weight field not a number — 0; no field — weight.default; count — all assigned ids (C06-POOL-FACTS-33-01)
without placement.weight — weight 1 for a readable row, 0 for an absent one
no field capacity in the heartbeat — capacity.default (C04-POOL-CAPACITY-0E-01)
a fractional capacity — as in the heartbeat, without rounding
